architecture: auction-consistent survival model, per-contract normalization, temperature scaling

competition_level_thresholds.derivation: tertiles of per-contract Valid-For-Bid candidate count, TRAINING PERIOD ONLY (1152 contracts)

unusual_project_thresholds.derivation: 5th/95th percentile of log(EE) within district, TRAINING PERIOD ONLY

data_entry_sanity_check.note: input-validation warning only, NOT the statistical unusual-project flag

feature_definitions.contractor_prior_winrate: strict-prior (<) mean is_winner for this FEIN, requires >=3 obs else district/global fallback
feature_definitions.contractor_prior_avg_ratio: strict-prior (<) mean ratio for this FEIN, requires >=3 obs else district/global fallback
feature_definitions.candidate_survival_fn: empirical CDF of a candidate's strict-prior ratios, tiered fallback: own(>=3) -> district(>=15) -> global
